name: my gallery
description: A site filled with photos that seems random but each with caption explaining the context and the memory behind the picture!  "Each photo has its own story to be told..!"

name: nightflash
description: A fun little chromium extension which creates night time vibes with night fog. And your cursor acts as a flash. With some fireflies for the vibess. It also has pop up menu with which you can disable it, change torch size, torch/light temperature and edit the number of fireflies you want in the screen (don't go overboard, it might lag).
